name: Chinedu Ezeofor
headline: Service Desk Analyst II — healthcare IT support, Active Directory/Epic, Make.com & n8n automation
experience_summary: I'm a Service Desk Analyst II at Matrix Global Services, covering the weekend shift for a healthcare client with 1,000+ users. I create user accounts in on-prem Active Directory (Windows Server AD DS) for a hybrid Microsoft 365 environment and add users to the groups and shared inboxes I have rights to. I reset passwords and clear account blocks across Active Directory, Epic, MyChart and Healthstream, with caller verification and a Duo push before any change, and I handle MyChart proxy access and consent rules, routing to Medical Records when a caller can't verify. I own status calls end to end in FreshService, reopening and re-prioritizing tickets when a problem is still happening, and I escalate what's locked down with the diagnosis already documented. I work in Citrix Workspace, an internal RDP app, and Zoho Assist for remote sessions. Earlier I supported Google employees through the Google x Multiverse apprenticeship and earned the Google IT Support Professional Certificate. Outside of work I run a small digital agency and build automations in Make.com and n8n, including an OpenAI API integration that generates copy and answers questions against spreadsheet data.
_notes: Updated 2026-08 from user interview. Matrix = PART-TIME weekend shift (Thu-Sun, ~26 hrs). Goal: KEEP Matrix as anchor, ADD a remote weekday-flexible part-time role, build agency. So search should favor part-time / flexible / contract, remote, NOT weekend-coverage roles. iManage was NYC Law Dept (2017-2021), NOT Matrix. No VDI/server-infrastructure claims - access is capped (printer installs behind UAC escalate to site support). CompTIA A+/Network+/Security+ NOT earned; Security+ in progress.
